title: Water and sewage
note: Pumps, filters, heaters, wells and septic systems. See docs/WATER.md.

flow_lph.label: Flow (L/h)
flow_lph.note: Liters an hour this part of a water line can pass (docs/WATER_FLOW.md). A well pump: what it lifts; a well gives this, or what the aquifer gives, whichever is less (docs/WELLS.md). A pipe (wire_kind water): what it carries (half inch 900, one inch 2400, two inch 9000). A filter, spigot, faucet, house inlet, tank fitting, water pump or hand pump: what it lets through. A water line gives no more than the narrowest part on its way, and WAILA names that part. Nothing trips: a part that is too small only slows the water.

pressurized.label: Pressurized
pressurized.note: A water tank that holds its water under pressure (a pressure tank, a water heater): a building's taps draw from it with no pump running. A plain cistern needs a water pump between it and what it feeds.

heater_w.label: Heater (W)
heater_w.note: A water heater: its element's watts. A water tank (wire_role water_tank) with a heater warms what it holds to 55 C while the building it stands in has power, drawing these watts while it heats.

filter_stage.label: Filter Stage
filter_stage.note: A water filter on a well's water line (wire_role water_filter): water reaching a tank through a sediment, a carbon and a uv stage is clean (drinkable); otherwise it is raw.

is_well.label: Drilled Well
is_well.note: A structure that is a drilled well: its recipe lines may scale with the depth to water (per_depth_m), it takes a sub panel (attach_item) and pumps into the tanks it is piped to.

sewage_capacity_l.label: Septic Capacity (L)
sewage_capacity_l.note: A septic tank structure (wire_role septic_tank): the liters it holds. Sludge builds up in it as the buildings piped to it drain (half as fast through a macerator pump); the liquid flows on to its distribution box and leach fields. Pumped out by the honey pot truck (docs/SEPTIC.md).

leach_lpd.label: Leach Rate (L/day)
leach_lpd.note: A leach field structure (wire_role leach_field): the liters a game day that soak away into the ground from it (docs/SEPTIC.md).

leach_storage_l.label: Leach Storage (L)
leach_storage_l.note: A leach field: the liters its gravel trenches hold while they soak away. When the fields are full the septic system backs up and the fixtures will not drain.
